verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents some AI features (auto-generating mock servers from a prompt, AI-generated Git commit messages) which count as AI-generated suggestions inside the product, but there is no evidence of AI analyzing a user's actual API/request/response data to surface insights or recommendations. Missing for 10: AI-driven analysis of existing collections/responses for insights, AI request/test suggestions based on user's own data, and independent confirmation of these AI features working well.
